name: nat-vent-evening-activation__hvac_fan
description: [hvac_fan twin of golden 'nat-vent-evening-activation'; Issue #1193] Evening cool-down: outdoor 70F < indoor 76F — nat vent activates for free cooling
source: Issue #1193: hvac_fan twin of golden 'nat-vent-evening-activation' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.

verdict.summary: [hvac_fan twin] When outdoor is cooler than indoor and below threshold, nat vent activates
verdict.observed_behavior: natural_ventilation with outdoor < indoor and outdoor < threshold
verdict.expected_behavior: natural_ventilation with outdoor < indoor and outdoor < threshold

events.note: evening: indoor at comfort_cool ceiling, outdoor 6F cooler — nat vent eligible. comfort_cool raised to 76 (Issue #392: reactivation gates now also require indoor <= ceiling_threshold for the default/HVAC-fan archetype used here — this scenario tests directional activation, not the ceiling gate)

assertions.reason: [hvac_fan twin] outdoor 70F < indoor 76F (beneficial direction); outdoor 70F < threshold 79F; indoor 76F > comfort_heat 70F; indoor 76F <= ceiling_threshold 76F — nat vent activates

notes: hvac_fan twin (Issue #1193): with the HVAC fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air is ventilation (fan on), not a pause. This scenario pins the ventilation/exit/setback decision only; it deliberately does NOT assert the cool setpoint that production also arms during hvac_fan ventilation (nat_vent_ac_assist_armed), which is the rule-3 question tracked in #1142.
